Asha: Heads-up: we hit a subtle output drift when stitching models with different KV encodings. Model loader rewrote KV scales (per-layer packing) after runtime bound attention kernels -> numeric mismatch.
Ben: that matches a class we didn't fully spec. We need a compact handshake: KV fingerprint + bind intent before kernel selection.
Carla: agree. keep it cheap for CI: runtime.compute_kv_fingerprint(profile) -> hex, compare fingerprints at load. If equal, reuse cache; if different, either convert or refuse.
Asha: propose manifest additions: kv_cache_profile, kv_fingerprint (optional), kv_convert_budget_ms, kv_conversion_allowed. Example snippet:```json
{"kv_cache_profile":"per_layer_scale_v2","kv_fingerprint":"a3f9c2","kv_conversion_allowed":true,"kv_convert_budget_ms":80}"```.
Ben: operationally we need three outcomes: MATCH (reuse), CONVERT (do on-load conversion within budget), REJECT (fail load and surface an actionable code). Runtime should have an API runtime.kv_compat_check(manifest_header) returning {status: MATCH|CONVERT|REJECT, reason, est_convert_ms}.
Carla: for failure automation we should return structured error codes so orchestrator can auto-redirect pipeline: e.g. QUANT_KV_MISMATCH with suggested_profiles. Example:```json
{"error":"QUANT_KV_MISMATCH","reason":"fingerprint-diff","suggested":["per_layer_scale_v1","fp16_kv"],"action":"convert_or_reject"}"
```. 
Asha: also tie into kernel bind handshake: loader must DECLARE bitwidths + kv_fingerprint before bind. Runtime may RESERVE kernels for declared set or reply NEEDS_REBIND if conversion changed footprint. Two bind modes: "reserve" and "lazy-bind".
Ben: reserve = preallocate superset (predictable SLOs), lazy-bind = bind on first request (lower startup cost). Manifest field bind_mode with default "reserve".
Carla: add safety: hysteresis_ms to prevent repeated convert/rebind thrash; metric kv_convert_count and kv_rebind_count. Ops alerts: kv_reject_rate > 0.5% over 10m -> investigate.
Asha: security/permissioning: some customers disallow on-node conversion for IP reasons. honour kv_conversion_allowed flag and refuse if false. If conversion is refused, runtime returns QUANT_KV_CONVERSION_FORBIDDEN.
Ben: QA: add a harness that runs model A -> model B with different fingerprints, assert outputs equal within tolerance after convert, and verify kernel cache integrity. Add a CI preflight check that calls runtime.kv_compat_check to detect incompat.
Carla: proto notes: negotiate(manifest_header) -> {match:boolean, can_convert:boolean, est_convert_ms:int, reserved_kernels_count:int, reason:string}. runtime.rebind(model_id, new_profile, timeout_ms) for force flows.
infra-bot: deploy-bot posted: "canary: kv-fingerprint + bind-handshake primitives rolled to canary cluster - watch eng-ml/canary-kv-compat" :rocket:
Asha: next steps: Ben to draft proto + API, Carla to write telemetry/alerts, I'll update RFC appendix with manifest examples and QA checks. Target canary by next Wed.
Ben: I'll open handshake PR today, pinging @eng-runtime for review.
Carla: i'll add SRE alerts and a small test harness repo.
Asha: thanks all, closing thread.
